from pyspark.sql.types import StructType
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, regexp_replace, explode, explode_outer, date_format, to_date, year
from notebookutils import mssparkutils
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

accountName = 'adlsfhirnonprod'
containerName = 'bronze'
relativePath = '30tb'
linkedServiceName = 'lsadlsfhirnonprod'

sasToken = mssparkutils.credentials.getConnectionStringOrCreds(linkedServiceName)

wasbPath = 'wasbs://%s@%s.blob.core.windows.net/%s' % (containerName, accountName, relativePath)
spark.conf.set('fs.azure.sas.%s.%s.blob.core.windows.net' % (containerName, accountName), sasToken)

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/" + relativePath + "/Observation/"
silverPath = "abfss://silver@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + relativePath

observationSchemaFile = bronzePath + "year=2016/"
observationSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(observationSchemaFile).schema

df = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(observationSchema).json(bronzePath)
df = df.withColumn("year", year(to_date(col("issued"))))
df = df.withColumn("month", date_format(to_date(col("issued")), 'MM'))
df = df.withColumn("day", date_format(to_date(col("issued")), 'dd'))

df = df.withColumn("subject",regexp_replace("subject.reference","Patient/","")).withColumn("encounter",regexp_replace("encounter.reference","Encounter/",""))
df = df.withColumnRenamed("id","observation_id")
df = df.withColumnRenamed("subject","patient_id_reference")
df = df.withColumnRenamed("encounter","encounter_id_reference")

df = df.select(
    "observation_id","resourceType","issued","status","patient_id_reference","encounter_id_reference","effectiveDateTime",
    "valueQuantity.code","valueQuantity.system","valueQuantity.unit","valueQuantity.value","valueString","year","month","day").toDF(*(
    "observation_id","resourceType","issued","status","patient_id_reference","encounter_id_reference","effectiveDateTime",
    "valueQuantity_code","valueQuantity_system","valueQuantity_unit","valueQuantity_value","valueString","year","month","day"
    ))

df.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Observation_main/")

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/" + relativePath + "/Observation/"
silverPath = "abfss://silver@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + relativePath

observationSchemaFile = bronzePath + "year=2016/"
observationSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(observationSchemaFile).schema

observationDf = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(observationSchema).json(bronzePath)
observationDf = observationDf.withColumn("year", year(to_date(col("issued"))))
observationDf = observationDf.withColumn("month", date_format(to_date(col("issued")), 'MM'))
observationDf = observationDf.withColumn("day", date_format(to_date(col("issued")), 'dd'))

observationDf = observationDf.withColumn("subject",regexp_replace("subject.reference","Patient/","")).withColumn("encounter",regexp_replace("encounter.reference","Encounter/",""))
observationDf = observationDf.withColumnRenamed("id","observation_id")
observationDf = observationDf.withColumnRenamed("subject","patient_id_reference")
observationDf = observationDf.withColumnRenamed("encounter","encounter_id_reference")

#Category
categoryDf = observationDf.select(
    "observation_id",
    explode(observationDf.category),"year","month","day").toDF(*("observation_id","category","year","month","day"))

categoryDf = categoryDf.select(
    "observation_id",
    explode(categoryDf.category.coding),"year","month","day").toDF(*("observation_id","category","year","month","day"))    

categoryDf = categoryDf.select("observation_id","category.*","year","month","day").toDF(*(
    "observation_id","category_code","category_display","category_system","year","month","day"))

categoryDf = categoryDf.repartition("year", "month")
categoryDf.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Observation_category/")

#Code
codeDf = observationDf.select(
    "observation_id","code.text",explode(observationDf.code.coding),"year","month","day").toDF(*("observation_id","text","coding","year","month","day"))

codeDf = codeDf.select("observation_id","text","coding.*","year","month","day").toDF(*(
    "Observation_id","code_text","coding_code","coding_display","coding_system","year","month","day"))

codeDf = codeDf.repartition("year", "month")
codeDf.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Observation_code/")

#Component
componentDf = observationDf.select(
    "Observation_id",explode(observationDf.component),"year","month","day")

componentDf = componentDf.select("observation_id",explode_outer(componentDf.col.code.coding),"col.code.text",
    "col.valueQuantity.code","col.valueQuantity.system","col.valueQuantity.unit","col.valueQuantity.value","year","month","day").toDF(*("observation_id","component_code","component_text",
    "component_valueQuantity_code","component_valueQuantity_system","component_valueQuantity_unit","component_valueQuantity_value","year","month","day"))   

componentDf = componentDf.select("observation_id","component_code.*","component_text",
    "component_valueQuantity_code","component_valueQuantity_system","component_valueQuantity_unit","component_valueQuantity_value","year","month","day").toDF(*("observation_id","component_code",
    "component_display","component_system","component_text",
    "component_valueQuantity_code","component_valueQuantity_system","component_valueQuantity_unit","component_valueQuantity_value","year","month","day"))

componentDf = componentDf.repartition("year", "month")
componentDf.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Observation_component/")

#Observation Value Codeable Concept
valueDf = observationDf.select(
    "observation_id",explode(observationDf.valueCodeableConcept.coding),"valueCodeableConcept.text","year","month","day").toDF(*("observation_id","coding","valueCodeableConcept_text","year","month","day"))

valueDf = valueDf.select("observation_id","coding.*","valueCodeableConcept_text","year","month","day").toDF(*("observation_id",
    "valueCodeableConcept_code", "valueCodeableConcept_display","valueCodeableConcept_system","valueCodeableConcept_text","year","month","day"))

valueDf = valueDf.repartition("year", "month")
valueDf.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Observation_valueCodeableConcept/")

bronzePath = "abfss://bronze@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/historic_data/" + relativePath + "/Claim/"
silverPath = "abfss://silver@" + accountName + ".dfs.core.windows.net/" + relativePath

claimSchemaFile = bronzePath + "year=2016/"
claimSchema = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").json(claimSchemaFile).schema

claimDf = spark.read.option("mutiline", "true").schema(claimSchema).json(bronzePath)
claimDf = claimDf.withColumn("year", year(to_date(col("created"))))
claimDf = claimDf.withColumn("month", date_format(to_date(col("created")), 'MM'))
claimDf = claimDf.withColumn("day", date_format(to_date(col("created")), 'dd'))

#Main
mainDf = claimDf.select(
    "id","resourceType","status","billablePeriod.end","billablePeriod.start","created","patient.display","patient.reference",
    "prescription.reference","provider.display","provider.reference","total.currency","total.value","use","year","month","day")

mainDf = mainDf.toDF(*( 
    "claim_id","resourceType","status","billablePeriod_end","billablePeriod_start","created",
    "patient_display","patient_id_reference",
    "prescription_reference","provider_display","provider_org_id_reference","total_currency","total_value","use","year","month","day"))

mainDf = mainDf.withColumn("patient_id_reference",regexp_replace("patient_id_reference","Patient/","")).withColumn(
    "provider_org_id_reference",regexp_replace("provider_org_id_reference","Organization/",""))

mainDf = mainDf.repartition("year", "month")
mainDf.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Claim_main/")

#Insurance
insuranceDf = claimDf.select("id", explode(claimDf.insurance),"year","month","day")

insuranceDf = insuranceDf.toDF(*("claim_id","insurance"),"year","month","day")

insuranceDf = insuranceDf.select(
    "claim_id","insurance.coverage.display","insurance.focal","insurance.sequence","year","month","day").toDF(*
    ("claim_id","insurance_coverage.display","insurance_focal","insurance_sequence","year","month","day"))

insuranceDf = insuranceDf.repartition("year", "month")
insuranceDf.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Claim_insurance/")

#Diagnosis
diagnosisDf = claimDf.select("id", explode(claimDf.diagnosis),"year","month","day")

diagnosisDf = diagnosisDf.toDF(*("id", "diagnosis","year","month","day"))

diagnosisDf = diagnosisDf.select("id","diagnosis.diagnosisReference.reference","diagnosis.sequence","year","month","day").toDF(*(  
    "claim_id","diagnosis_reference","diagnosis_sequence","year","month","day"))

diagnosisDf = diagnosisDf.withColumn("diagnosis_reference",regexp_replace("diagnosis_reference","Condition/",""))

diagnosisDf = diagnosisDf.repartition("year", "month")
diagnosisDf.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Claim_diagnosis/")

#Procedure
procedureDf = claimDf.select("id",explode(claimDf.procedure),"year","month","day")

procedureDf = procedureDf.toDF(*("id","procedure"),"year","month","day")

procedureDf = procedureDf.select("id","procedure.procedureReference.reference","procedure.sequence","year","month","day").toDF(*(
    "claim_id","procedure_reference","procedure_sequence","year","month","day"))

procedureDf = procedureDf.withColumn("procedure_reference",regexp_replace("procedure_reference","Procedure/",""))

procedureDf = procedureDf.repartition("year", "month")
procedureDf.write.format("delta").mode("overwrite").partitionBy("year", "month").save(silverPath + "/Claim_procedure/")
